scope: Translate the frozen SP500 M30 v3 ledger into contract exposures; not a native US500_x100 price-feed backtest or new edge test

specification_source.live_mt5_status: Both sandbox and external read-only initialization failed with IPC timeout (-10005)
unverified_assumptions: current contract rules apply to all historical candidates
same price path, spread and slippage as US500
same commission per unit of index exposure: 0.25 USD round trip for US500, 25 USD per x100 lot
US500 reference maximum volume remains the frozen v3 value

sizing: Floor current closed-equity risk budget divided by planned loss per lot to volume_step, cap at volume_max, skip below volume_min; never round upward
margin_policy: Static entry-margin sensitivity: entry_fill times contract_size times lots times margin_rate. Skip if margin plus modeled round-trip commission exceeds equity. Do not downsize. No maintenance/stop-out simulation.
limitations: No native x100 historical quotes or live symbol_info verification
Margin stress is constant, not historically timed
No alternative re-entry path after a skipped frozen-ledger trade
No live orders; no strategy changes; no promotion verdict
